evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce EgoProbe, a benchmark that evaluates streaming egocentric memory along these two complementary dimensions: long-range retention, i.e., how far, and event-specific recall under interference, i.e., how exact.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Even when models correctly answer coarse-grained questions, they often fail to recall the specific details of the designated event.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Extensive evaluation across diverse models reveals substantial limitations in long-range recall, with further challenges in recovering target-event details among related experiences.
